frames.caption: Setup: post player on a spot by the block · passers on the wing with a ball
1. Post: wide and low like a sumo wrestler, one hand up — “Ball!”
2. Wing passes to the target hand (bounce pass at U6)
3. Catch with two hands and chin it — look at the rim
4. One power step to the rim, shoot off the backboard
5. Rotate: passer → post · post → back of the passer line
Switch to the other block after a few turns

notes.title: Big Target Post Catch (also: Show Your Hands, Post Target Drill, Wide and Strong)
notes.objective: Young players learn the basic post position: wide base, big target hands, catch, chin the ball, and score off the backboard.
setup: One player on the block (a poly spot marks it)
One passer on the wing with a ball
rules: Post player gets wide and low on the spot, one hand up as a target, and calls "Ball!".
Wing passes (bounce pass at U6) to the target hand.
Post catches with two hands and chins it.
Post makes one power step toward the rim (no dribble at U6) and shoots off the backboard.
Rotate: passer to post, post to the back of the passer line. Switch blocks.
variations: Easier: coach hands the ball to the post player.
Harder: one dribble power move to the rim.
Harder: add a defender behind the post holding a pad or pool noodle for light contact.
coaching: Big feet — wide like a sumo wrestler.
Catch, chin, look at the rim.
Shoot off the box on the backboard.
